cohort: 1211 healthy pregnant or lactating women in northern, central, and southern China
finding: The study found that approximately 25% of pregnant or lactating women in China had suboptimal retinol concentrations, with variations observed across different stages of pregnancy and lactation, regions, and socio-demographic factors.
mod_finding: Lactating women who had a caesarean birth or were breastfeeding exclusively were more likely to have suboptimal retinol concentration.
